# KMP-FaceLink

> Unified face, hand, and body tracking SDK for Kotlin Multiplatform. One API across Android (MediaPipe + CameraX), iOS (ARKit + Vision), JVM/Desktop (ONNX Runtime), and Wasm (MediaPipe JS). Provides 52 ARKit-compatible blend shapes, head transform, hand landmarks, gesture classification, and body pose estimation via a reactive Kotlin Flow API.

## Docs

- [API Overview](https://github.com/rioX432/KMP-FaceLink/blob/master/docs/api-overview.md): Full module reference with architecture diagram, key types, code examples, and common use cases
- [Quick Start: Android](https://github.com/rioX432/KMP-FaceLink/blob/master/docs/quick-start-android.md): Camera setup, MediaPipe model download, permissions, and tracking in 5 minutes
- [Quick Start: iOS](https://github.com/rioX432/KMP-FaceLink/blob/master/docs/quick-start-ios.md): ARKit configuration, XCFramework integration, and SwiftUI usage with SKIE Flow bridging
- [Integration Guide](https://github.com/rioX432/KMP-FaceLink/blob/master/docs/quick-start-integration.md): Gradle and SPM dependency setup with version catalog examples
- [Extension Strategy](https://github.com/rioX432/KMP-FaceLink/blob/master/docs/extension-strategy.md): Module architecture, roadmap, and SDK design philosophy
- [On-Device LLM](https://github.com/rioX432/KMP-FaceLink/blob/master/docs/on-device-llm.md): Model selection, benchmarks, and hybrid routing for the LLM module
- [Dokka API Reference](https://rioX432.github.io/KMP-FaceLink/): Generated KDoc reference for all public APIs
- [Detailed LLM Reference](https://github.com/rioX432/KMP-FaceLink/blob/master/llms-full.txt): Expanded API signatures, all module details, and platform-specific notes

## Modules

- [kmp-facelink](https://github.com/rioX432/KMP-FaceLink/tree/master/kmp-facelink): Core tracking — face (52 blend shapes + head transform), hand (landmarks + gestures), body (33 keypoints), holistic (combined). Platforms: Android, iOS, JVM, Wasm.
- [kmp-facelink-avatar](https://github.com/rioX432/KMP-FaceLink/tree/master/kmp-facelink-avatar): BlendShape to Live2D (ParamAngleX, ParamEyeLOpen, etc.) and VRM parameter mapping. Platforms: Android, iOS, JVM, Wasm.
- [kmp-facelink-actions](https://github.com/rioX432/KMP-FaceLink/tree/master/kmp-facelink-actions): Gesture triggers, expression triggers, combined triggers, emotion classification (FACS-based), DefaultStreamBindings for stream interaction. Platforms: Android, iOS, JVM, Wasm.
- [kmp-facelink-interact](https://github.com/rioX432/KMP-FaceLink/tree/master/kmp-facelink-interact): Streaming platform event sources (Twitch EventSub, YouTube Live Chat). MockStreamEventSource for demo/testing. StreamEventAggregator for multi-platform. Platforms: Android, iOS, JVM, Wasm.
- [kmp-facelink-voice](https://github.com/rioX432/KMP-FaceLink/tree/master/kmp-facelink-voice): TTS (OpenAI, ElevenLabs, Voicevox), ASR (Whisper on-device), multilingual lip sync. Experimental.
- [kmp-facelink-llm](https://github.com/rioX432/KMP-FaceLink/tree/master/kmp-facelink-llm): Streaming LLM API — cloud (OpenAI, Anthropic), on-device (Gemma 3n, llama.cpp), hybrid routing. Experimental.
- [kmp-facelink-pipeline](https://github.com/rioX432/KMP-FaceLink/tree/master/kmp-facelink-pipeline): AI avatar pipeline orchestration: ASR -> LLM -> TTS -> LipSync -> Expression. Experimental.
- [kmp-facelink-vmc](https://github.com/rioX432/KMP-FaceLink/tree/master/kmp-facelink-vmc): VMC Protocol (OSC over UDP) sender/receiver for VRM apps (VSeeFace, VMagicMirror).
- [kmp-facelink-ifm](https://github.com/rioX432/KMP-FaceLink/tree/master/kmp-facelink-ifm): iFacialMocap protocol output compatible with VTube Studio.
- [kmp-facelink-stream](https://github.com/rioX432/KMP-FaceLink/tree/master/kmp-facelink-stream): WebSocket streaming server for phone-as-tracker use cases. Experimental.
- [kmp-facelink-vts](https://github.com/rioX432/KMP-FaceLink/tree/master/kmp-facelink-vts): VTube Studio Plugin API direct integration via WebSocket.
- [kmp-facelink-networking](https://github.com/rioX432/KMP-FaceLink/tree/master/kmp-facelink-networking): Shared UDP socket, time utilities, mDNS discovery. Internal module used by protocol modules.

## Gradle Plugin

- Plugin ID: `io.github.rioX432.facelink` ([Gradle Plugin Portal](https://plugins.gradle.org/plugin/io.github.rioX432.facelink))
- Automates MediaPipe model downloads (face, hand, body) with SHA-256 checksum verification
- Apply in your Android module's `build.gradle.kts`, configure via `faceLink {}` DSL
- Replaces manual model download tasks — models are fetched automatically before build
